detailed_results.question: Which departments have an average doctor salary greater than 200000, and what is their average doctor salary?
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(doc.salary) FROM departments d JOIN doctors doc ON d.dept_id = doc.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name HAVING AVG(doc.salary) > 200000
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT avg(salary) ,  dept_name FROM doctors JOIN departments ON doctors.dept_id = departments.dept_id GROUP BY dept_name HAVING avg(salary)  >  200000

detailed_results.question: List the full names of patients and their doctors for all completed appointments in the Cardiology department.
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, doc.first_name, doc.last_name FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN doctors doc ON a.doctor_id = doc.doctor_id JOIN departments d ON doc.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE a.status = 'Completed' AND d.dept_name = 'Cardiology'
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T2.first_name ,  T2.last_name FROM patients AS T1 JOIN doctors AS T2 ON T1.patient_id  =  T2.patient_id JOIN appointments AS T3 ON T2.doctor_id  =  T3.doctor_id WHERE T3.status  =  'completed' AND T2.specialty  =  'Cardiology'

detailed_results.question: Find the names and specialties of doctors who have billed more than the average billing amount across all appointments.
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT doc.first_name, doc.last_name, doc.specialty FROM doctors doc JOIN appointments a ON doc.doctor_id = a.doctor_id WHERE a.billing_amount > (SELECT AVG(billing_amount) FROM appointments)
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.specialty FROM doctors AS T1 JOIN appointments AS T2 ON T1.doctor_id  =  T2.doctor_id WHERE T2.billing_amount  >  ( SELECT avg(billing_amount) FROM appointments )

detailed_results.question: What is the total billing amount generated by each doctor, ordered by total billing from highest to lowest?
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT doc.first_name, doc.last_name, SUM(a.billing_amount) AS total_billed FROM doctors doc JOIN appointments a ON doc.doctor_id = a.doctor_id GROUP BY doc.doctor_id, doc.first_name, doc.last_name ORDER BY total_billed DESC
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  sum(T2.billing_amount) FROM doctors AS T1 JOIN appointments AS T2 ON T1.doctor_id  =  T2.doctor_id GROUP BY T1.first_name ORDER BY sum(T2.billing_amount) DESC

detailed_results.question: What is the total account balance for each customer in New York?
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(a.balance) FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'New York' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT sum(balance) ,  first_name ,  last_name FROM accounts JOIN customers ON accounts.customer_id  =  customers.customer_id WHERE city  =  'New York' GROUP BY first_name ,  last_name

detailed_results.question: Find the transaction details and branch names for all debit transactions exceeding 2000 dollars.
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT t.transaction_id, t.amount, t.txn_date, b.branch_name FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN branches b ON a.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.txn_type = 'Debit' AND t.amount > 2000
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.transaction_id ,  T1.txn_type ,  T1.amount ,  T1.merchant ,  T1.status ,  T2.branch_name FROM transactions AS T1 JOIN branches AS T2 ON T1.branch_id  =  T2.branch_id WHERE T1.txn_type  =  'debit' AND T1.amount  >  2000

detailed_results.question: Which branch manages accounts with an average balance higher than the overall average account balance across all branches?
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, AVG(a.balance) FROM branches b JOIN accounts a ON b.branch_id = a.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name HAVING AVG(a.balance) > (SELECT AVG(balance) FROM accounts)
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT T1.branch_name FROM branches AS T1 JOIN accounts AS T2 ON T1.branch_id  =  T2.branch_id GROUP BY T1.branch_name HAVING avg(T2.balance)  >  (SELECT avg(balance) FROM accounts)

detailed_results.question: What is the total inventory value on hand in the Chicago Logistics Terminal warehouse?
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(i.quantity_on_hand * p.unit_cost) FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Chicago Logistics Terminal'
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity_on_hand * unit_price) FROM inventory WHERE warehouse_id = (SELECT warehouse_id FROM warehouses WHERE city = 'Chicago Logistics Terminal')

detailed_results.question: List suppliers who have supplied products with a total purchase order amount greater than 50000 dollars.
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT s.company_name, SUM(po.total_amount) FROM suppliers s JOIN purchase_orders po ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name HAVING SUM(po.total_amount) > 50000
detailed_results.predicted_sql: SELECT T2.company_name FROM purchase_orders AS T1 JOIN suppliers AS T2 ON T1.supplier_id = T2.supplier_id GROUP BY T1.supplier_id HAVING sum(T1.total_amount)  >  50000
